data.script: Oliver: Band practice, take one! Drums, ready? … Maya: Too loud! My glasses are dancing on the table! … Oliver: Okay, okay. Volume down to five. Better? … Maya: Better. But now the singer is too quiet — I can't hear the words. … Oliver: Ingrid, one step closer to the microphone! … Maya: Now the guitar… the guitar is fine. The song is just too fast. … Oliver: Too fast? It's rock, Maya! … Maya: Then my experiment needs new rules: no science next to the music room on Thursdays!

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the viewpoint? The boy with red hair and a yellow shirt. … Maya: That is Oliver. Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass? … Maya: That is Maya. Look, Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the girl with fair hair and a dark blue jacket? … Maya: That is Ingrid. Look, Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey.
